title: parastrephia lucida
intro: Parastrephia lucida, commonly known as the Chilca plant, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and its antioxidant properties, which can help protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of Parastrephia lucida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
